title: client
summary: MSUI implements the current Benilla client-writer surface tracked here: auth session, character creation, messagechat, the complete channel join/leave/list/administration family, played time, random roll, text emotes, creature and pet-name queries, ordinary movement, ping, teleport, all six force-speed acknowledgements, the complete root/water-walk/feather-fall/hover mode-ack family, and CMSG_MOVE_SPLINE_DONE after server-owned self rides.

openItems.text: CMSG_CHANNEL_* moderation builder family remains absent; JOIN_CHANNEL, LEAVE_CHANNEL and CHANNEL_LIST are implemented
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: ChannelPackets, WorldSession, and NetworkClient now implement the exact one- or two-cstring builders for the contiguous PASSWORD-through-MODERATE family; law-owned slash routing makes every sender reachable without colliding with party invite/kick commands.
2026-08-21: empty CMSG_PLAYED_TIME is sent by /played; the exact two-u32 response and visible breakdown are clinically checked in ChatClinicalChecks.
2026-08-21: /random serializes the exact two-u32 minimum/maximum request and strictly decodes the four-field broadcast.

openItems.text: CMSG_TEXT_EMOTE (u32 textId, u32 emoteNum, u64 target): absent - /wave etc. cannot be sent
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: SendTextEmote writes the exact 16-byte text-id, emote-number-zero and full target-GUID body; emote command aliases route to it.

openItems.text: CMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY (pet number + guid): absent - NPC-summoned pets stay nameless
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: exact opcode 0x0052 sender and u32 pet-number + u64 full-GUID body are implemented and clinically byte-pinned.

openItems.text: CMSG_MOVE_SPLINE_DONE: opcode-table-only (Net/Opcodes.cs:269), never built/sent after server-driven splines
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: WorldSession.BuildMoveSplineDoneBody writes the live endpoint MovementInfo, newest u32 spline id, and mandatory real-client 1.0 completion fraction. Ground/flying self rides park normal physics and input, cut-short stops ack the replacement id, and teleport hand-backs abort without a duplicate ack. Focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: Live-verify Charge/forced ground motion, taxi completion, and a server-cut-short self spline: the avatar should follow the path under input lock, send one exact CMSG_MOVE_SPLINE_DONE for the newest id, resume at rest, and emit no duplicate ack when a teleport hands control back.

Live-verify on an authenticated owned private channel that password clearing/setting, owner query/transfer, moderator/mute/invite/kick/ban toggles, announcements, and moderation each produce the expected server notice and that numbered selectors continue to address the server-confirmed channel slot.

CMSG_FORCE_*_SPEED_CHANGE_ACK: only the RUN opcode is in the table (0x00E3) with no handler for SMSG_FORCE_RUN_SPEED_CHANGE and no ack builder - server speed changes are never acknowledged (vmangos will kick/rubber-band)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: All six exact SMSG/CMSG force-speed pairs are present. The ack builder writes full u64 GUID, echoed u32 counter, live MovementInfo and exact f32 speed; focused golden-wire coverage passes.

openItems.text: move-flag acks for water-walk/feather-fall/hover (move_flag_ack with apply dword): absent - only the root/unroot ack exists
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: All six non-root grant/remove SMSGs are parsed and acknowledged on the three exact CMSG opcodes with full GUID, echoed counter, live MovementInfo and trailing u32 apply.
